records.text: In a clip, JD Vance says the administration cut taxes on overtime, Social Security, and tips for middle American workers, rather than just Washington and New York elites.
records.speaker: JD Vance

appearances.snippet: There is a lot of good that we've done over the past 18 months. We cut taxes bigly. We cut taxes on overtime, Social Security, and tips. ... Those are tax cuts for middle American workers, not just for the elites in Washington and New York City.
